instruction: Create a Thunderbird filter to mark all incoming emails for the Outlook account as read automatically.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a message filter in Thunderbird to forward all emails from anonym-x2024@outlook.com to anonym-x2024@gmail.com. Opened Message Filters dialog, created new filter named 'Forward to Gmail' with 'Match all messages' condition and 'Forward Message to' action.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird UI, open Message Filters dialog, create new filters, select match conditions (Match all messages), change action types from dropdown, enter values, save filters
metadata.task_rationale: Tests filter creation with 'Mark read' action. The agent demonstrated ability to create filters and select different actions from the dropdown, so this variation requires selecting a different action type.
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a message filter that marks all incoming emails as read. Evaluator reads msgFilterRules.dat and checks for a filter with action 'Mark read' and condition ALL.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads msgFilterRules.dat from the Outlook account's IMAP folder (outlook.office365.com), targeting the right account as specified in the instruction.
Expected type is 'rule', so get_rule returns the rules dict directly. check_thunderbird_filter receives it as the 'rules' parameter and accesses rules.get('expect', []) correctly.
Metric check_thunderbird_filter correctly parses the filter file, extracts filter records (name, enabled, type, action, actionValue, condition), and uses _match_record to verify expected properties.
Expected values (enabled='yes', action='Mark read', condition=['ALL']) correctly cover all instruction requirements: filter is active, marks as read, applies to all incoming emails.
Postconfig closes the Message Filters dialog before file retrieval, ensuring the filter file is saved to disk.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: get_vm_file returns Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]] but check_thunderbird_filter expects str. In practice this works correctly for single-file configs (returns str or None, and None is handled at line 91), but a type annotation mismatch exists.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
